title: GENESIS: Gene-Specific Machine Learning Models for Variants of Uncertain Significance Found in Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia and Long QT Syndrome-Associated Genes
summary: Primary Methods show gene-specific LR/MLP models trained with 10-fold CV on curated pathogenic/benign variants for RYR2, KCNQ1, KCNH2 and SCN5A, then applied to ClinVar/exome VUS. Results report model comparisons, blinded KCNQ1 patch-clamp tests (including a discordant V106D prediction), prospective family cosegregation for G245R/V241I, and blinded retrospective clinical correlation of 9/10 cases. Admit narrowly as an AI-enabled channelopathy variant-interpretation finding; it is not a prospective clinical utility trial. Validation is reported in the original source; its scope and limitations are stated in the decision rationale.
